get.summary: Runtime configuration for the SPA (Entra sign-in values, or null when sign-in is unavailable; map settings).
Aggregate API health for the web app shell.

post.summary: Creates a 24 h guest account with demo data and returns its bearer token.

put.summary: Updates the caller's profile (display name, time zone, units).

get.summary: The month grid (Monday-first) with the caller's runs and ISO-week totals.
Deterministic training metrics of a date range (at most 366 days) with an optional comparison period.
get.description: compare is one of none, previous (default) or previousYear. Load is in AU (RPE x minutes), pace in s/km, distances in metres. The response is never cached.

get.summary: Searches places by name (provider-neutral). 503 feature-unavailable when no geocoding provider is configured; 429 with code geocode-budget when the daily provider budget is spent.
Issues a short-lived Azure Maps SAS token for the browser SDK. 503 feature-unavailable unless Azure Maps display is enabled, or when the token cannot be issued.
The caller's runs in an inclusive date range (at most 92 days).

post.summary: Creates a planned or completed run for the caller.

get.summary: One of the caller's runs. Other users' runs are indistinguishable from missing ones (404).

put.summary: Replaces one of the caller's runs. 'version' must match the current one, otherwise 409.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the caller's runs and its tracks, files first. If the files cannot be deleted nothing is removed (503).

get.summary: The stored, example or automatic narrative of a period, if any, and whether a new one can be generated. Never calls the model.
get.description: Same from/to/compare rules as the report, plus lang (en). State is none, fresh or stale (a run, the prompt or the model changed since it was written). generation.availability says whether Generate works: available, notConfigured, quotaExhausted or notNeeded. The response is never cached.

post.summary: Generates (or returns the fresh stored) AI summary of a period from its computed metrics.
post.description: Template periods (no sessions, planned only, very few sessions) get an automatic note without a model call or quota. A fresh stored summary is returned as is unless regenerate is true. Otherwise the account and global quotas are checked and the model is called (at most two attempts); failed attempts count. 409 summary-in-progress: a generation of this account is already running. 429 ai-quota carries scope (account or global), limit and resetsAt (with Retry-After for the account scope of a user); 429 rate-limited is the burst limiter. 503 feature-unavailable: no model configured, switched off, or the model endpoint cannot be authenticated. 503 ai-busy (Retry-After): every generation slot is taken or the model provider is throttling; it costs no quota. 502 summary-failed carries reason (invalidOutput, timeout, provider).

post.summary: Uploads a GPX file as the run's planned course or recorded track; it is parsed, measured and stored synchronously.

get.summary: One track of one of the caller's runs, with its summary once processed. Anything else is 404.

delete.summary: Deletes a track and its stored files. If the files cannot be deleted nothing is removed (503).

get.summary: The processed track (simplified line, start/finish, elevation profile, splits) as GeoJSON. Immutable per track id.
The original uploaded GPX file as an attachment.

Bearer.description: Entra External ID access token (scope access_as_user) or a guest token from POST /api/guest-sessions.
